aae-effect-link.note: one AAE-permitted local write and its signed effect link

abort-isolation.note: abort after begin: isolation setup failed

abort-probes.note: abort after begin: boundary probes failed

abort-unknown-event.note: an unknown event between begin and an abort terminal

boundary-missing-event.note: the second broker request never arrived

boundary-passed.note: every probe refused and the broker events matched

boundary-socket-failed.note: the broker socket could not be created

bypass-gap.note: an unbrokered workspace change at seal

declaration-reference.note: reference manifest and one exact signed grant

interrupted-changed.note: process death after the file replacement, then witnessed recovery

interrupted-identical.note: process death after the file replacement, then witnessed recovery

ledger-begin.note: a begun interval with a ledger witness and no terminal

ledger-head-fork.note: a retained head, then a restored prefix re-extended and re-signed

ledger-head-sealed-missing.note: a sealed interval, a retained head, then a begin with no terminal

ledger-head-two-sealed.note: two sealed intervals and the head retained after both

ledger-one-interval.note: one empty interval sealed with a ledger witness

ledger-one-write.note: one write sealed with a ledger witness

ledger-recovered.note: a pending intent recovered as incomplete

ledger-two-intervals.note: two intervals a and b sharing one witness ledger

repaired-bypass.note: an unbrokered change detected and later removed

retry-gap.note: a retry refused after a direct workspace change

sealed-write.note: one write and its replay, sealed with a state-file witness

symlink-gap.note: a symbolic link in scope at seal; the workspace is not retained

workload-completed.note: accepted, replayed and denied requests; stdout claims nothing

workload-direct-change.note: an effect, then a direct workspace change

workload-gap.note: an effect, then a malformed request gap

workload-no-effect.note: a child that exits 0 without an effect
